title: Fourth Time
paragraphs: We knocked on the door of the weapon shop, which had already closed. A faint light was leaking out, suggesting they hadn’t gone to bed yet.
“What’s this? I was just about to hit the sack… Oh, it’s you guys from earlier today. And you, the guy with the spear, this is your first time here. And the rest…”
The Queen peeked out from her robe.
“Y-Your Majesty!? I mean, Your Highness!?”
The weapon shop owner bowed deeply.
“W-Why are you here!?”
“I’m conducting a little investigation in secret. Please raise your head and treat us as you normally would.”
Ren and Itsuki nodded, seemingly convinced by the weapon shop owner’s reaction.
“Sorry for bothering you so late.”
“S-So, what brings you here at this hour? If it’s weapons you want, can’t it wait until tomorrow…?”

Oh? He’s suddenly speaking very politely. Is it because of the Queen? We mentioned the story about the chainmail that Father bought earlier in the day. However, while the Crimson Swine’s face was vaguely remembered, the Queen had a clear recollection.
“I wouldn’t feel good knowing that something from my shop was used for a crime. But if you’re returning it, I’ll throw in a little extra next time you stop by.”

By the time we returned in the previous loop, the shop was already closed. Should I mention that? No, the future will likely be different this time, so it should be fine. After that, I also requested the meteorite iron series from the weapon shop owner. Perhaps because the Queen was with us, he brought them from the warehouse immediately.
“To think you even have such rare items… Perhaps you should be appointed the royal court’s exclusive blacksmith.”
“Th-That’s more than I deserve… But if possible, I’d still like to sell weapons to regular adventurers.”
His speech was a mix of formal and casual.
“Alright, we’ll be borrowing these then.”
“Yeah.”
Ah… I should also remember not to mention anything about copying weapons.
“Well, we’ve confirmed everything, so we’ll take our leave now.”
“Yeah, I’ll be looking forward to seeing you again.”
And with that, we left the weapon shop. By now, Ren and Itsuki should be fully convinced.
“Indeed… There’s no way to know about those hidden weapons in that shop without coming from the future.”
“Why was it hidden in the first place?”
“If I told you at the start, not only I but also Naofumi would have been nearly killed and forced to leave the country.”
“I see. So, you’re following the best possible route?”
“Then why did you loop again this time?”
Oh, they asked.
“Did you make a mistake or lose during a wave?”
“Possibly.”
Oh? Ren and Itsuki seem to have come to their own conclusion.
“We’ve gathered enough evidence. But to catch Aultcray red-handed…”
“Are we going to wake up Naofumi now and talk to him?”
“No, if we wake him now, won’t he think we’re the culprits?”
“Exactly. Based on my knowledge from the loops, it’s best to intervene when he’s being falsely accused.”
“…You’re right. If we protect Naofumi when he realizes he’s been deceived, he’s more likely to trust us.”
“Last time, we pretended to be deceived and caught them in the act. We also heard about it from the Queen last time.”
With that, we planned for the events of the next morning. Trash, and the Crimson Swine. You’re already surrounded.
“By the way, because of the loop, there may be things I’ll tell Ren, Itsuki… and Naofumi later that might be hard to believe.”
“Got it.”
“Yeah, given the situation, it’s probably best to believe it.”
“Last time, Ren and Itsuki had a lot to say about not believing certain things. Especially about what I… really want to call Naofumi and why.”
“Is… is there something?” Itsuki asked nervously.
“Well… you’ll understand that after you clear Naofumi’s false charges tomorrow.”
I’m tempted to talk about it now, but it’s better to wait until Father is present. Ren and Itsuki agreed with that plan last time as well.
“For now, we should focus on eliminating the country’s conspiracy, right?”
“Exactly. If we silently try to leave the country, the Three Hero Church will relentlessly pursue us.”
“That’s a troublesome scenario. The question is… can we believe all this?”
Itsuki had a sour look on his face.
“Either way, everything will be revealed tomorrow. If Motoyasu tells us then, it might be worth listening to.”
“…Indeed.”
“Well then, Heroes, I’ll see you tomorrow.”
The Queen gave a bow. After that, the Queen returned to Fiancé and mentioned that she would be on standby in the attic all night. It seems she wants to make sure to secure the evidence.
“See you tomorrow.”
“Yeah.”

We dispersed, just like in the previous loop. Everything else proceeded almost exactly the same. In the morning, the Crimson Swine will come waddling to me with a false accusation, and I will pretend to be deceived and head to the castle to speak with Trash. Ren and Itsuki’s reactions will be almost identical to last time. The Queen is also expected to make an appearance later. Now, I’m in the throne room, waiting for Father to be brought in. Ren, Itsuki, and I exchange glances and nod. I’m getting fed up with the lies from the Crimson Swine and Trash. When you know the truth, this whole charade just feels ridiculous. Eventually, Father is brought in wearing only his undergarments, and Ren and Itsuki seem convinced. They realize that this is a conspiracy and that Trash and the Crimson Swine are the true villains. Of course, with everything going so smoothly, it’s only natural that doubts might arise about whether I’m pulling the strings behind the scenes. Ren and Itsuki from the previous loop had pointed that out. I won’t forget to take care of that aspect properly this time.
“Myne!”
Ah, how pitiful. Every time I see this, my heart aches. Last time, I managed to return the chainmail to Father. I’ll do the same this time.

Father… I remember how, unlike in the first world, he was kind to everyone and even cooked for me, Ren, and Itsuki to show his gratitude. I may never see that version of him again, but I will save this Father. Father is someone who returns kindness with kindness and harshness with severity. However, that severity is merely a reflection of how he treats others. With strangers, he may be cautious, but if they do no wrong, he responds with goodwill. That’s why Father is praised in the prophecy of the Four Heroes Church.
“W-What’s with that attitude?”
Father looked around at everyone, speechless. He probably feels like he’s being interrogated. Ren, Itsuki, and I look at him with sympathy. Father, who is unknowingly being framed.
This time… I will even get back the clothes that the Crimson Swine stole from him!
“Do you truly have no memory of this?”

Of course, he doesn’t. This is all an act to let Trash and the Crimson Swine show their true colors. I’ve already explained to Ren and Itsuki that we can go along with the flow and get closer, just like last time. Things are unfolding exactly as I said, and Ren and Itsuki look a little unnerved. But this is exactly what happened in the previous loop.
“I don’t know what you’re talking about… wait, ah!”

Father’s timing for realizing things hasn’t changed at all. That chainmail belongs to Father, but I also want to return the clothes the Crimson Swine stole from him. I forgot last time, but this time, I’ll make sure Father doesn’t lose anything.
“So, you’re the pillow thief!”
“Who’s a pillow thief!? I never imagined they’d be such vile scum!”
“‘They’? Vile scum? What are you talking about?”
Oops, I slipped up again. That was something Father warned me about in the previous loop. I need to reflect on that. But at this point, it’s checkmate.
“Well then, what are the charges against the Shield Hero?”
“Charges? What are you talking about?”
“Buhi… Buhibuhibuhi!”
“Huh?”
“Bububububububuhibuhibuhi—!”
The Crimson Swine wailed and approached me. Ugh, I feel sick. That filthy, vile creature shouldn’t even be breathing near me.
“Buhihihihi, buhihi!”
“Eh?”
Father’s face turned to one of pure disbelief.
“What are you talking about? After dinner last night, I just went to my room and slept.”
Exactly. And on top of that, Fiancé was keeping watch in the attic all night. Father’s innocence is now indisputable. There’s no way Fiancé would lie. Now, I need to play my part.
“Lying like that… then why is she crying so much?”
“Why are you defending Myne? And where did you get that chainmail?”
This belongs to Father. I took it back from the Crimson Swine. I’ll return it immediately. Just thinking that made my expression loosen a bit.
Father tilted his head slightly, reading my expression. Father, you’ve always put up with my selfishness. When I wished to see Filo-tan again, you even asked Ren and Itsuki to help search for her.

I haven’t forgotten how much I owe you for raising more Filolials than ever before. Even though we never found Filo-tan, Father, I haven’t forgotten how hard you worked to investigate. In this loop, I will gather even more Filolials to aid in finding Filo-tan. Father, I’m counting on you.
And for that… this is a necessary trial. I will clear away all your grief, Father!
“Ah, yesterday, I went to a tavern alone to drink, and while we were drinking together for a while, they gave me this chainmail as a gift.”
“Huh?”
Just a little more time until the agreed moment.
“That’s right! King! I was robbed in my sleep—my entire fortune and all my equipment except my shield were stolen! Please, catch the culprit!”
“Silence, you scum!” Trash roared.
Heh… it’s almost over for you. Thinking he trapped Father, you’re the one about to be ensnared by your own wife. You’ll fall into the trap set by the wife who comes from the future.
“Forcing your vile desires on unwilling citizens is an unforgivable atrocity. If you weren’t a Hero, you’d be executed immediately!”
“I’m telling you, it’s a misunderstanding! I didn’t do it!”
In the previous loop, I was only focused on Father at this moment, but this time I’ll glance at Ren and Itsuki. Oh… Ren and Itsuki are surprisingly good actors. They’re giving nasty, sinister grins.

They know exactly what’s going on and are acting it out. Their expressions are nothing like what Ren and Itsuki would normally show. The soldiers press Father’s head down to the ground as the three of us stand in a circle around him.
“You! So you pinned a false crime on me just to steal my preparation money and equipment!”
Ah, that voice… it reminds me of the Father from the first world. The great Father from that world… are you watching? I’ll save Father as many times as it takes.
“Don’t mess with me! You were after my money from the start, weren’t you? You planned this with your comrades to distribute the equipment!”
I glance at Father with a gentle expression.
“How many faces do you have!?”
Oh dear, Father misunderstood.
“Bububuu.”
The Crimson Swine jeered. How annoying. I glare at her with murderous intent.
Father tilted his head again.
“Coming to another world and having comrades pull something like this… it’s disgusting.”
“Indeed. I have no sympathy either. I had my doubts, but now I’m sure.”
“Exactly. Father—I’ll save you now!”

I removed the chainmail with one hand and swept away the soldiers restraining Father with my spear. They had such sinister smiles… it makes me want to kill them. Should I kill them? The voices of the Father and others from the previous loop echo in my head, telling me to stop.
“Uwaaaahhh!”
As Father regained his freedom, I offered him my hand to help him up.
“It’s okay now. Here, I’m returning this.”
Then I handed the chainmail to Father.
“Eh…? Eh?”
“Motoyasu-dono!?”

Trash wore a shocked expression, realizing things had not gone as he had imagined. You’ll understand soon enough. After all, you’ll be used by the Crimson Swine and witness the downfall of the kingdom even after your death. Well, I’ve been told not to kill them this time. I’ll enjoy watching how this plays out.
“This is a conspiracy. Fa—Naofumi didn’t do it. I believe him.”
“Yes, Naofumi-san is innocent. You can’t fool us.”
“You’re trying to divide us and manipulate us for your own gain, but we won’t let that happen.”
Ren and Itsuki pointed their weapons at Trash, the Crimson Swine, and the kingdom’s soldiers.
“You’ve been running wild while the Queen was away, but what do you think she’ll say when she sees the state of this kingdom?”
“D-Damn you!”
Ah, any moment now… that demon will arrive with killing intent. Victory is already in my grasp. All that’s left is to buy time until the Queen arrives.
Ren and Itsuki don’t trust you, and the Queen is coming. You’re already caught in the trap. You thought you were setting the trap, but you’re the one caught—how laughable.
“This is the fourth time I’ve protected Father here. This is my conviction. No matter how many times I’m warned, I will never change.”
Yes, my determination, my wish, and my loyalty to Filo-tan… All of it is poured into this.
“I’ve come from the future to repay my debt to you, Father.”
… For some reason, the air froze a little.
“Why are you calling Naofumi-san ‘Father’?”
“Yeah. You’ll explain later, right?”
“I’ll explain later.”
“Eh? Eh? Eh?”
Father stared at us in shock.
“It’s no surprise. I didn’t believe Motoyasu-san either until he showed me the evidence.”
“Yeah, I was almost made a fool too.”
“By the way… they’ll be here soon, right? Timing-wise, where are they hiding?”
“I don’t know. But it’ll be any moment now.”
Ren and Itsuki have already distanced themselves from their comrades. After all, they know betrayal is coming.
